superpod.source: Huawei Atlas 950 SuperPoD product page (16 compute + 4 UB interconnect cabinets, ≤ 1,024 NPUs, 64 NPUs + 16 CPUs per cabinet), read 2026-10-19

superpod.rackSwitches.source: UB-Mesh, arXiv 2503.20377 §3.3.1 (72 low-radix switches per reference cabinet of 64 NPUs); Hot Chips 2025 Liao slide 9 (64 + 1 NPUs, 16 CPUs per rack)
superpod.rackSwitches.note: the paper’s reference cabinet applied to the shipped Atlas 950 cabinet (same 8 × 8 NPU mesh)

superpod.podUplinksPerNpu.source: LightCounting 2026-07-21 (128 × 800G OSFP per compute cabinet = 2 per NPU)

superpod.cpusPerNode.source: Huawei Atlas 950 SuperPoD product page: 64 NPUs + 16 Kunpeng 950 per compute cabinet; LightCounting 2026-07-21: 8 NPU trays + 8 CPU trays per cabinet → 16 CPUs / 8 NPU trays = 2 per 8-NPU node
superpod.cpusPerNode.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: the count is vendor arithmetic; which 8 NPUs one CPU failure interrupts (the blast radius of the CPU class) stays an assumption

superpod.podSwitchRadix.source: Hot Chips 2025 Liao slide 9: 128 × 100 Tb/s UB switches in a one-tier Clos for 8,192 NPUs at 2 × 800G per NPU → 16,384 ports / 128 switches = 128 ports × 800G per switch (100 Tb/s / 800 Gb/s = 125 → 128)
superpod.podSwitchRadix.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: was assumed; the radix follows from the slide’s switch count and bandwidth

superpod.transceiversPerLink.source: LightCounting 2026-07-21: 128 × 800G OSFP per compute cabinet (NPU side) and 4,096 modules for 1,024 NPUs including the switch side → 2 links × 2 ends per NPU

scaleOut.source: bandwidth per NPU: Atlas 950 white paper 2 × 400G UBoE, splittable into 4 × 200G (vendor); planes / tiers / radix: by analogy with the Ascend 960 SuperPoD cluster (HC2026: two-tier four-plane Clos, Xinghe UBG radix up to 1,024) as the attachments apply it to the 950
scaleOut.note: reconciled 2026-10-21: was derived; the network design is an analogy, only the per-NPU bandwidth is a stated value

assumed.zh: 每节点 2 CPU：每柜 16 颗鲲鹏 ÷ 8 个 NPU 托盘（厂商数值的算术）；一颗 CPU 故障中断哪 8 张卡（影响域）为假设
assumed.en: 2 CPUs per node: 16 Kunpeng per cabinet ÷ 8 NPU trays (vendor arithmetic); which 8 NPUs one CPU failure interrupts (its blast radius) is assumed

assumed.zh: 超节点层交换 128 × 800G、每超节点 16 台：由 Hot Chips 2025 的 128 台 100 Tb/s 交换机 / 8,192 NPU 推得

assumed.zh: 每条光链路 2 只光模块：LightCounting 含交换侧共 4,096 只 / 1,024 NPU
